items.title: Uber Redesigns M3DB Sharding with Subclusters to Limit Failure Impact
items.summaryShort: Uber Redesigns M3DB Sharding with Subclusters to Limit Failure Impact. Uber has redesigned shard placement in M3DB with fixed size subclusters to limit the impact of node failures, maintenance, and cluster scaling.

items.title: Oura's $2.2B IPO is mostly a payday for existing shareholders
items.summaryShort: Oura's $2.2B IPO is mostly a payday for existing shareholders. Forerunner Ventures plans to sell its entire stake in Oura for as much as $1.26 billion, according to Oura's latest IPO filing.
